notes: Sequential alternating fresh-process control/candidate pairs. Four server workers on CPUs 0-3, identical frozen verifying client on CPUs 4-7; 64 peers/32 pairs, window16, 10 seconds. All values/order checked. Frozen traffic client intentionally drops its 64 TCP handles at timing end; transport/write-error counts account for each. Other resource, timeout, Close, admission and protocol checks must pass. CPU includes setup/teardown; histogram percentiles are upper bounds.
